pipeline: final submission: stage 1 (5-fold b0) -> existence gate -> R2 refinement -> assembly -> cleanup -> SE2
code: src/filseg_infer.py, src/filseg_infer_r2b0.py (run), src/filseg_infer_se.py (constants defined there; this file documents them)

provenance_keys.nested_cv: chosen on the training folds and scored on the held-out fold (nested), adopted under a rule registered before the result
provenance_keys.rule: fixed by a registered rule before any result, not tuned
provenance_keys.recipe: training/architecture choice, validated as a whole
provenance_keys.plateau: checked afterwards by nested automatic tuning (records/tune_nested/): changing it does not improve held-out PQ

preprocessing.provenance: recipe; the window contains the whole solar disk and every annotation (scripts/data_audit.py)

stage1.model: U-Net, ResNet-101 encoder (ImageNet init), 1 input channel, 1 output channel (smp 0.6.0 Unet equivalent)
stage1.training: 60 epochs, last epoch; BCE + soft Dice; one annotation set drawn per visit (seeded)
stage1.upsampling: logits bilinear to 1808^2 before the sigmoid, placed in a 2048^2 canvas
stage1.ensemble: each model's probability rounded to float16; float32 mean rounded to float16

existence_gate.provenance: nested_cv (scripts/tune_post.py); plateau, the only sensitive constant (records/tune_nested/sensitivity.csv)

candidates.keep_if: overlaps the existence gate by >= 1 px

r2_refinement.window_mean: per-candidate mean of the sigmoid over its windows, rounded to float16
r2_refinement.provenance: recipe; nested validation records/nested_r2b0/; adopted by a post-hoc decision (docs/validation.md)

cleanup.provenance: rule (20 px; 5 %, the MAGFiLO QA rule); nested_cv neutral-or-better, plateau

se2.fragment_candidates: stage-1 candidates (p > 0.3, >= 20 px) that overlap a small component (p > 0.5, 100-499 px) and do not touch the >= 500 px gate
se2.refinement: R2_final at native resolution (same windows and channels as the R2 stage), per-candidate mean over windows
se2.model: ResNet-101 stem + layer1 + layer2, global average pool, linear (5.9 MB)
se2.training: refined fragments of all 707 training images, each out-of-fold (stage 1 = mean of the 4 inner models that never saw the image, refinement = R2n of its outer fold); 25 epochs, batch 64, flips + rot90, seed 2026
se2.target: mean over the image's annotation sets of (IoU of the refined mask with that set's best instance if > 0.5 else 0); deterministic, every set
se2.tau_rule: 0.6 x 0.2124 (PQ/2 of the pipeline before SE2, out of fold). m maximises the leaderboard-type PQ V1 (annotation sets of an image pooled) on a pre-defined grid {0.6, 0.8, 1.0, 1.25, 1.5}: per outer fold on the other 4 folds (0.6 in folds 0, 2, 3, 4; 0.8 in fold 1); at test time the V1 maximum over all 707 training images (scripts/se2_analysis.py select, records/se2/analysis/threshold_v1.json). No test information.
se2.add_if: score > tau and zero pixel overlap with the existing instances
se2.provenance: post hoc: the criterion was changed from the first-order V0 gain to V1 after an exploratory all-fold sweep had been seen; the final threshold does not pass the registered SE2 rule (E1, E3, E4, E5 fail); docs/validation.md

nested_auto_tuning_check.result: V0 +0.0003 [-0.0015, +0.0023] for tuning the post-processing constants (gate, assembly threshold, merge IoU, min area, part size, island fraction; measured with an earlier small-fragment stage) per outer fold; registered switch rule (CI lower bound > 0) not met, constants kept
